texts: doha about being born again and again, with a thread, and this human birth being rare
My grandmother winds a thread round her wrist at every festival and prays she will not have to come back again; she says this one human life is the chance
thread, endless births
Write a doha about the thread of birth after birth that ties the soul to the world, and how this rare human life is the one chance to cut that thread and stop returning
Life after life the thread is wound, and only in the human birth can the hand that spins it learn to let go
Write a doha in which a traveler fills a pot of water at a roadside and walks on, like the soul taking birth after birth, and this human birth is the rare chance to stop wandering
doha with a pot of water and a traveler, how many births we go through
pot of water, traveler, rebirths
My uncle is a traveler who carries a pot of water everywhere, and when he falls ill he says he doesn't want a next round of this; he wants this life to count
The traveler fills his pot of water and walks on, as the soul carries its thirst from birth to birth
Birth upon birth, death upon death, the soul circles like a bird that cannot find its branch
doha about how we keep being born and dying again and again
Standing at my newborn niece's bed one week after my father's funeral, I felt the whole turning of it, one arriving as one leaves, and I wondered how many times I have done this
Kabir said that human birth is rare and hard to obtain, that countless lives were spent as creatures before this one, so write me a doha that makes me value this chance and not waste it
cycle of births
Write a doha in which stars repeat their rounds in the night and a rope winds up and down, just as the soul comes and goes again and again, until it uses this human birth to break away
stars, rope, rebirth cycle
doha with stars and a rope, born again and again until we get free
Looking at the stars from the roof I wondered how many times I have been here, and my grandmother tied a rope to the cot and said, this life is the rope you must climb out with
The stars return each night and the rope goes down and up again, and the soul that is born again must learn to climb
A rainbird called outside the window the morning my daughter was born and a boat left the harbour in the mist; I felt that she has come back for another round, and I want her to make use of it

Please write a doha in which a rainbird calls for rain and a boat crosses and returns, again and again, like the soul coming and going through countless births, until it finds the shore in this human life
doha with a rainbird and a boat, about being born again and again
rainbird, boat, rebirth
The boat returns to the bank it left, and the rainbird cries for the same drop, and so is the soul that is born again
Bead by bead the prayer beads go round, birth by birth the soul goes round, and only one bead is the human birth

Write a doha in the manner of Kabir about prayer beads that turn in a circle without end, like the soul turning through birth and death, and say that this rare human birth is the bead at which to stop
doha with prayer beads about being born again and again
My mother counted her prayer beads all evening, and when I asked what she wished for, she said that she hopes not to have to return, that this life is enough
prayer beads, many births
Please write a doha that tells how the soul has taken birth in eighty-four lakh forms and now has the rare human body, and that it must not waste this chance to end the cycle of coming and going
doha about getting a human birth after so many lives, dont waste it
After a million forms the soul stands in the human frame, like a pauper who has found a gate ajar
rare human birth
When my son was born after years of trying, my grandmother whispered that he has earned this birth through many lives, and I want a doha to tell him not to squander it
A fish in the pond jumped and a stone fell, and the ripples spread and vanished, and my grandmother said that is how the soul returns in birth after birth, in widening circles
fish, stone, birth cycle
The stone falls, the fish leaps, the ripple goes out and back, and the soul returns to the same pond again
Write a doha where a fish, who has been many creatures in many lives, finds a stone and uses it to climb out of the water, as the soul uses this rare human birth to leave the cycle of return
doha with a fish and a stone about being reborn again and again
doha about a lion and being born again and again until we are free
lion, many births
Please write a doha in which a soul that was once a lion and many other creatures now has the rare human birth, and in it must learn to leave the endless cycle of arriving and departing
The lion at the zoo made my guru say that we have all been animals in our past lives, and now in this human life we have the chance to stop coming back
Once a lion, once a worm, now a man: the soul has worn many coats but only this one has hands to untie the knot
From the water well comes up a bucket full and goes down empty, and the soul rises and sinks in the cycle of births until it finds sandalwood-like peace
well, sandalwood, rebirth

Write a doha where the bucket goes down and up the water well again and again, and sandalwood perfumes the hand that draws it, and say that the soul too returns again and again until it uses this human birth
doha with a well and sandalwood about births and deaths repeating
My grandfather drew water from the well in the morning and burned sandalwood in the evening, and said these two were all he needed to remind him that we come and go in circles
Write a doha in which the dew on the grass is born at night, dies at noon and is born again at dawn, like the soul taking birth after birth, though only in the human body can it be free
The dew is born at dawn and dies at noon and returns again the next night, as the soul does in its many bodies
Every morning the dew appears on my garden and by the afternoon it is gone, and I thought of my grandmother who said we come back too, until we learn what we came to learn
doha with dew about being born again and again
dew, endless returns
doha about coming back again and again until we wake up
Kabir said it is only in this human birth that the soul can end its wandering from womb to womb, so please write a doha that tells the reader how precious this body is for that single purpose
From womb to womb the soul has wandered, and this is the one gate that opens onto the road out
human birth, rare chance
At my friend's baby shower the old women kept saying this child has come back from somewhere, and I asked myself what chance I have been given this time
cuckoo, rainbird, rebirth
The cuckoo and the rainbird both returned this spring, as they do every year, and it made me think about how the soul returns in life after life
The cuckoo returns each spring and the rainbird each monsoon, and the soul returns each lifetime, hoping this time to stay free
doha with a cuckoo and a rainbird about coming back again and again
Write a doha in which the cuckoo and the rainbird come back every year to the same branch, as the soul returns to a new body, and say this human life is the year to stay free
doha with a house and a yogi about births and rebirths
The yogi leaves the house behind in this life and the next, and so goes round until he leaves it for good
Write a doha in which a yogi enters a house and leaves it, only to return to another one in the next life, unless he uses the human birth to leave the round of arriving and leaving
house, yogi, rebirth
The yogi who stayed in our neighbour's house said that he had been in that very house in an earlier life, and all of us laughed; but I keep thinking about how many homes we must have had
Please write a doha that says the soul has been dying and being born for countless ages, and that this human life, hard to get, is the chance to stop the coming and going, so nobody should waste it
doha about the endless cycle of birth and death, we should use this life
cycle of births
I held my dying grandfather's hand and my newborn nephew's hand in the same week, and I felt both were just passing through the same gate again and again
The cradle and the cot of dying are two gates of the same hall, and the soul keeps walking through both
At the naming ceremony of my cousin's baby, the elder said this soul has come many times and may it be the last, and I felt that I wanted to remember that for my own life
A birth is a knock on a gate that has been knocked a thousand times before, and this time the soul may stay out
many lives, one chance
doha about coming back again and again and this being our chance to stop
Write a doha in the voice of Kabir that says the soul has taken a body countless times and returned empty, and that only in this rare human body can it do the work that ends the returning
The pot of water is filled and spilled and filled again, and the soul is born and spent and born again
I watched my mother fill the pot of water in the morning and spill it out to the plants in the evening, again and again for fifty years, and I thought of the soul doing the same across its lives
pot of water, rebirths
doha with a pot of water, about being born again and again
Write a doha in which a pot of water is filled and emptied every day, like the soul poured into a body and poured out, and say this human life is the one in which to stop the pouring
Round the circle of the womb and the pyre the soul goes, and this human body is the only gate in the circle
Write a doha that says that those who waste this human body spend it on food and sleep and quarrelling and will have to be born again, but those who use it find the way out
human body, rare chance
After my father passed away, my mother said we are born into the same family many times, and that you must make this time count; I want a doha on that
doha about birth and death repeating over and over
doha with a bell, births and deaths going round and round
Write a doha in which a bell rings at every birth and every death, again and again, and say those who hear only a sound go round, while those who wake in this human birth find release
The bell at our village rang for my newborn nephew and for my aunt's funeral in the same month, and I felt we are all just going round and round
The bell rings for the birth and rings for the dying, and the soul between the two strokes goes round again
bell, birth and death
The potter and clay make the pot, the pot breaks, the clay returns, and the soul takes form again and again until it is freed
My neighbour's potter and clay supply shop ran for a century, with the same clay used for new pots and old ones; that is how the soul is, my guru said, recast again and again
doha with a potter and clay about being born again and again
Write a doha in which the potter and clay give shape to a vessel that breaks and is reshaped many times, as the soul is born again and again, and this human life is the final firing
potter and clay, rebirths

Please write a doha about a milk bowl and a diamond, saying that the soul has gone through countless lives as milk goes through many stages, but in this human birth it becomes a diamond that cannot be broken
milk, diamond, human birth
doha with milk and a diamond, born again and again until we are free
The milk is churned through many lives and in the human birth it hardens to a diamond that no hammer can break
My grandfather poured milk for the diamond merchant who visited every year, and said, a soul too must be shaped many times before it becomes clear; I want a doha for that
The beggar and the musk deer both wander in search of what they carry within, birth after birth, until they stop and look inward
doha with a beggar and a musk deer, being born again and again
A beggar sat near a musk deer sculpture and my grandmother whispered, he has begged in many lives and will not stop until he looks inward; I want a doha on this
Write a doha in which a beggar and a musk deer both wander through life after life in search of what they carry within, and in this rare human birth one of them may finally turn inward and be free
beggar, musk deer, rebirth
Write a doha in which ash and prayer beads both go round and round, as the soul goes through birth and death, until this human life lets it step out of the circle
doha with ash and prayer beads, born again and again
At the cremation we were given ash to scatter, and my mother clutched her prayer beads and said she hopes this is the last time she has to come back; I want a doha for her
From ash to womb, from womb to ash, the prayer beads turn, and the soul repeats its prayer in every birth
ash, prayer beads, rebirth
washerman, bell, rebirths
The washerman washes the cloth many times as the bell tolls many hours, and the soul is washed in birth after birth
doha with a washerman and a bell about births and deaths again and again
The washerman at our lane has been washing the same family's clothes for four generations, and the evening bell has rung for each, and I think the soul goes through such cycles too
Write a doha where the washerman washes cloth by the water again and again while the bell rings the hours, as the soul is washed in countless births until it is clean enough to stay free
Write a doha about a water well from which the same water is drawn and spilled over and over, as the soul is born and dies in an unbroken round, and the rare human birth that can break it
well, endless births
doha with a well about being reborn again and again
My grandmother drew water from a well that her grandmother dug, and said the soul is like that water, drawn up and poured back again; she told me to use this human life well
The bucket falls into the well and comes up again, and the soul falls into the womb and comes up again
I got a thorn in my foot at my cousin's naming ceremony and my aunt said sins come back with us from life to life like that thorn; I want a doha on using this birth to pull it out
The thorn of the old desire goes with the soul from womb to womb, and only the human hand can pull it out
thorn, rebirths
doha with a thorn about coming back again and again until it's pulled out
Write a doha in which a thorn lodged in the foot goes with the soul through many lives, since the soul carries its desires into each new birth, until the human birth lets one pull it out
My physician friend delivered babies by day and sat with the dying by night, and said she sees the same soul walking in and out; I want a doha to put that into words
doha with a physician about births and deaths again and again
physician, endless rebirths
The physician sees the soul arrive and sees the soul depart, and wonders how many times it has done both

Please write a doha in which a physician who has helped at countless births and deaths realises that the soul comes and goes again and again, and uses this rare human body to find the cure for the cycle
Kabir said those who find the human body but do not seek the Lord will be born again in lower forms, so write me a doha that warns about this in clear and simple words
My friend wasted his twenties drinking, and I said such a life is not coming again for him; we then talked about how rare this human chance is
rare human life
doha about not wasting this human birth or we come back again
The rare human birth, if wasted, is a handful thrown on rock, and the soul must wait for another monsoon
doha about being born again and again and how to stop

Please write a doha that says all creatures are bound to the round of coming and going, and the human being alone has the intellect to find the way out, so this body must not be wasted in idle pleasure
births without end
After a month-long illness, my sister sat up and said she has the feeling that she has been here before and might be back again; I want a doha for her
Birth after birth the wave rises and falls, and only the human wave can know it is water
The yogi and the one-string lute both repeat the same note, and the soul repeats its birth, until the note is heard truly
doha with a yogi and a one-string lute about coming back again and again
A yogi plays the one-string lute near our lane and he told me that he has no fear of death because he knows he will be back, but he wants to be done with returning
Write a doha in which a yogi plays a one-string lute with only one song, the song of leaving the cycle of births, and says that the human birth is the instrument on which to play it
yogi, one-string lute, rebirth
philosopher's stone, many births
Please write a doha in which the soul seeks the philosopher's stone across a thousand lives, and finds in the human birth that it was the chance to leave the cycle itself
doha with a philosopher's stone about being born again and again
My grandfather sought a philosopher's stone all his life, and as he died he said it was this human life, which I keep wasting; I want a doha about it
The soul seeks the philosopher's stone in a thousand lives, and finds it when it looks into its own human hands
The shroud is wrapped and unwrapped across the ages, and the blind man wanders from womb to womb without sight
Write a doha in which a blind man stumbles through life after life with a shroud waiting at the end of each, and say that in this human birth he may at last learn to see and stop returning
The blind man who begs near the shroud seller's lane says he has wandered in the dark for many lives and hopes this one is his last; I want a doha for him
shroud, blind man, rebirths
doha with a shroud and a blind man, born again and again
My uncle has a rare book that says a soul gets a human body only after eighty-four lakh births, and I've kept thinking about how I spend my days; I want a doha to remind me
Eighty-four lakh doors have closed behind the soul, and the one that is open now is the human one
Kabir said that after wandering through all forms of creatures the soul at last gets a human body, and this is its one chance, so please write a doha that tells the reader not to waste it
doha about getting a human birth after so many lives
eighty-four lakh births
The date palm bears its fruit high and the soul climbs door after door of birth, and only the human door opens to the top
date palm, door, rebirth
doha with a date palm and a door, about coming back again and again
The date palm in my grandfather's garden was planted by his father, and the door of the old room was never replaced; I feel I have been through that door in other lives
Write a doha in which a soul passes through door after door like climbing a date palm one branch at a time, and the human birth is the last door that opens onto the fruit
doha about being born and dying over and over again
Death is only a corner turned, and the road of births goes on until the traveller wakes
endless coming and going
Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir that explains how the soul, after dying, enters a new womb and is born again and again, and that only the human body allows it to find the way to freedom
When my uncle died a day before his grandson was born, the whole family said it is the same soul coming back, and I could not stop thinking about what that means
The soul comes and goes like a guest in a place that is never its own, until it learns the one name that ends the visiting
doha about being born again and again, do your best in this life
many lives, one chance
Please write a doha in which the soul arrives and departs in life after life like a tired guest, and say that the human body is the rare chance to do the work that ends the repeated returning
After my grandmother's death I dreamed she told me that she is glad to have had one more human life, and that I should not waste mine; I want a doha for the dream
philosopher's stone, milk, rebirths
Write a doha in which milk turns to curd to butter through many changes, as the soul passes through many births, and the philosopher's stone of the human body is the last step to freedom
doha with a philosopher's stone and milk, being born again and again
My uncle kept a philosopher's stone legend and a jug of milk by his bed, and said that a soul too is made again and again, like milk made into curd, before it is ready
Milk becomes curd, curd becomes butter, and the soul becomes the human, who alone can find the philosopher's stone
The palace in our town changes owners every generation, and an old man there said that souls also move from body to body like that, and that this one body is our best chance
palace, endless births
The soul occupies a palace for a lifetime and leaves it empty, and moves to a new one, until it finds the home that does not change
Write a doha in which a soul moves from one palace-like body to another, life after life, and finally, in the human birth, learns that the only home worth seeking is the one that never needs leaving
doha with a palace about coming back again and again
My cousin is expecting and the whole family says our grandfather has come back, and I wonder what each soul is doing here and how many times it has done this before
Please write a doha that tells how each soul returns to the world after death, how birth and death keep turning, and how the rare human body should be used for freedom and not wasted
One is carried out and another carried in, and the great turning of births goes on without a pause
doha about how we keep coming back after dying
births and deaths
river, birth after birth
doha with a river about being born again and again
The river returns as rain and the rain returns as river, and the soul returns as body, until it learns the way home
Write a doha in which a river flows to the sea and rises again as rain, again and again, as the soul passes through birth after birth, and the human body is the one chance to stop the circle
We scattered my father's ashes in the river and my aunt said he will come back, and I thought about how many times we each have been through the river
When my daughter was born I felt that I was meeting someone I had known for many lives, and I want a doha to remind us both to make this life count

Please write a doha that says the soul has circled in birth and death countless times and has been wasted in each, and this human life is the rare chance, so let the reader seek truth before it is lost
rare human birth
The soul has travelled through a million forms to reach the shore of the human, and standing there it may either sleep or cross
doha about not wasting this human birth, we dont get another
doha with a grindstone and a mirror, about births and deaths going round
grindstone, mirror, rebirths
The grindstone turns and the mirror reflects the turning, and the soul sees in the human glass that it has been round before
Write a doha in which the grindstone keeps turning and the mirror shows the face of one who has been born many times, and say that this human birth is the chance to stop grinding the same grain again
I looked in my grandmother's mirror next to the grindstone and she said I looked just like someone from her previous life; I want a doha about coming back and not wasting this chance
doha with a tree and a winnowing fan about being born again and again
tree, winnowing fan, rebirths
The tree sheds and regrows, the winnowing fan sifts and returns, and the soul is sifted through birth after birth until it is light enough to rise
Please write a doha in which a tree drops its leaves and grows them again, while the winnowing fan separates the grain, as the soul is sifted through many births until this human life can free it
My grandfather sat under the tree each autumn with the winnowing fan and said that we are winnowed again and again until the chaff of desire is gone; I want a doha for him
palanquin, rebirth cycle
The palanquin carries a bride in one life and a corpse in another, and the soul inside never stays in either
My aunt was carried in a palanquin at her wedding and her last journey was in a different kind of carriage, and I felt the cycle is much shorter than we think
doha with a palanquin about being born again and again
Write a doha in which a palanquin carries a bride in one life and a body in another, as the soul changes its form again and again, until in the human birth it chooses to walk out of the procession
The dew is born at dawn and gathered in a net of spider silk, and the soul is caught in the net of birth and rises, only to fall again
dew, net, rebirths
doha with dew and a net about being born again and again
Please write a doha in which the dew is trapped in a net and falls and forms again each morning, as the soul is caught in the net of births, and this human life is the chance to cut it
I watched the dew on a spider's net this morning and thought how each drop will fall and form again, and how this life is the one in which to break the net
A skeleton was found under a tree, and the old man said it has been round before; make a doha about the return of souls and not wasting this life
The tree stands over the skeleton and the skeleton lies under the tree, and the soul between them passes through both again
skeleton, tree, rebirths
Write a doha in which a tree grows from the place where a skeleton lies, and that skeleton once belonged to a soul that has been born many times, and may be freed in the human body
doha with a skeleton and a tree, about being born again and again
many lives, one chance
The round of endless births turns slowly, and the human life is a pause in which the soul may step off
My father's death and my son's birth came in the same winter, and I couldn't help thinking that all of us are going around in some great circle
doha about the circle of birth and death and using this life right
Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir that says the circle of births has no beginning and has no end for the heedless, but the person with a human body who seeks the truth can step out
Write a doha where the tongue repeats the sorrows of countless births and the soul cries out in its many bodies, and say that this human birth is the chance to speak the Name that ends the returning
tongue, rebirths
The tongue has tasted a thousand births and called for a thousand mothers, and only the human tongue can call the Name
My grandmother says her tongue has said the Name in many lives and she hopes this one is the last; she repeats it with every breath
doha with a tongue about births and deaths coming again and again
Write a doha in which a potter and clay shape a pot that breaks and is reshaped many times, like the soul taking body after body, until this human form is the pot that holds the nectar
doha with a potter and clay about birth and death going round
At the potter and clay shop in our lane the same clay gets used for new pots over and over, and my grandfather said we are like that; I want a doha for him
potter and clay, rebirths
The potter and clay make a thousand shapes from one lump, and the soul too has been a thousand vessels
The thief of desire steals the soul back to the world each time it nearly escapes, and so it returns birth after birth
doha with a thief about being born again and again
thief, rebirths
A thief took my neighbour's savings on the day his grandson was born, and the old man laughed and said that it's a thief who brings us back each time too, the thief of desire
Write a doha in which the thief called desire steals the soul back into a new womb each time it nears release, and say that in this human birth the soul must catch the thief
